7007912.en: It's an enjoyable fight though without a winner.
7007912.ch: 你我势均力敌，今日也算比了个痛快。

7007921.en: {callSchool|A}, our Sect has a Secret Technique that would let you temporarily step down from the {post|A} position and disguise yourself as a True Disciple to take part in the Sect Tournament. Are you willing?
7007921.ch: {callSchool|A}，我宗现有一秘法，可以让您暂时卸下{post|A}职位，伪装成真传弟子出战宗门大比，请问您可愿意？

7008001.en: We <r>{0}</r> are about to mount an attack against <r>{1}</r>. {callSchool|A}, prepare for battle to crush the enemy!
7008001.ch: 我<r>{0}</r>即将发动对<r>{1}</r>的进攻，大战一触即发，请{callSchool|A}做好准备，力克敌宗！

7008002.en: We {0} are about to mount an attack against {1}. Though they have the assistance of {2}, they are still no match for us. {callSchool|A}, prepare for battle to crush the enemy!
7008002.ch: 我{0}即将发动对{1}的进攻，即便对方有{2}的支援，想必也无法阻挡我宗之威。大战一触即发，请{callSchool|A}做好准备，力克敌宗！

7008003.en: <r>{0}</r> is about to mount an attack against our <r>{1}</r>. {callSchool|A}, prepare for battle to defend our sect!
7008003.ch: <r>{0}</r>即将发动对我<r>{1}</r>的进攻，大战一触即发，请{callSchool|A}做好准备，牢守宗门！

7008004.en: {0} is about to mount an attack against our {1}. A strong sect like us with the assistance of {2} will surely repel the enemy with ease. {callSchool|A}, prepare for battle to defend our sect!
7008004.ch: {0}即将发动对我{1}的进攻，然我宗不仅实力强劲，还有{2}从旁支援，想必能够轻松取胜。大战一触即发，请{callSchool|A}做好准备，牢守宗门！

7030000.en: {call|B|A}, you look pale. Before I joined the sect, I learned a secret technique called "Spirit Platform Reversed Nether Ultimate Ten Techniques Number Two". It can be used for soothing therapy. Let me cure you of your illness!
7030000.ch: {call|B|A}，你看来气色不佳。我昔日未入宗门之际，在外习得一门秘术，叫做“灵台倒悬沧溟颠转奥义十术残篇遗教二式”，据说可以安静心神，我来为你祛除身上病恙吧！

7030001.en: What? You can do that?! {call|B|A}, you're such a nice guy to do this for me!
7030001.ch: 啊！原来真的可以？！{call|B|A}很有义气嘛，这都肯给我试！

7030002.en: Well, I know this name is too plain to be attractive. Even after I said its name, you still don't have confidence in me, {call|B|A}!
7030002.ch: 啊，我就知道这名字太过朴实，不够吸引，我说出道法的名字，{call|B|A}都没有信心！

7030003.en: {call|B|A}, you don't seem well. It happens I have some elixirs here. Take them, or you'll be too vulnerable in the wild.
7030003.ch: {call|B|A}身体似乎不是很健康，恰逢我身上有丹药数枚，便请服下，否则闯荡在外易遭凶险。

7030004.en: {call|B|A}, you were heavily wounded in the fierce battle and almost succumbed to the wound. Luckily, I decocted the Three-legged Crow Claw I obtained a long time ago with Bambuki Slough and Yong Ning Soil for 49 days, and made an elixir called "Liberation" that saved your life.
7030004.ch: {call|B|A}，你于激战中身受重伤，几乎死去。所幸我昔年曾得三足乌之爪，和以竹妖褪衣、永宁仙壤，于鼎中热煎四十九日，终于合得一丸“解脱”，让你服下，否则后果不堪设想。

7030005.en: By the way, it is my original prescription and is rarely used, so you'd better lie in bed for a little longer just in case. This is all I can do for you...
7030005.ch: 对了，师弟。此丸为我独创之秘，很少使用，最好你多躺躺，看看有没有什么不良后果。嗯，师兄我也只能帮到这了……

7030006.ch: 外门弟子不可随意进入！

7030007.en: Oh?! A new initiate with good quality? That's good news!
7030007.ch: 哦？！竟是个资质不错的新门人？不错不错！

7030008.en: Well well, I admire your ambition! Take this and work hard from now on. You should come here often to participate in the important affairs of our sect.
7030008.ch: 呵呵，志气不错！此物你且收下，盼你努力进取，以后也来到此处商量宗门大事。

7030009.en: {call|B|A}, I've been traveling a lot lately and have some new understandings of cultivation. How about we share our experiences and understandings to improve together?
7030009.ch: {call|B|A}，我最近在外游历，于修为进境多有心得，你我互相参研，好一起进步，如何？

7030010.en: {call|B|A} has shown great enthusiasm sharing newly-reaped understandings. Almost six hours passed as {gender|B} talked on and on...
7030010.ch: {call|B|A}盛意拳拳，竟将近日心得和盘托出。{gender|B}，说了足足有三个时辰……

7030011.en: Hmph, {call|B|A}, you joined the sect not long ago, yet you have made so much progress. I really envy you! Let's have a spar, {call|B|A}! Show me some tricks to impress me!
7030011.ch: 哼，{call|B|A}入门未久，却修为进展神速，实在好叫我羡慕！不如{call|B|A}露两手，与我切磋切磋，好叫我开开眼界？

7030012.en: {call|B|A}, are you not confident in your skills or do you think I'm not your match? Hmph, forget it then!
7030012.ch: {call|B|A}是不敢还是不屑与我切磋？哼，就此别过。

7030013.en: You... You... My stomach is aching... Let's do it some other day.
7030013.ch: 你……你……今日我肚子痛，先不打，咱们改日再战。

7030014.en: You accept the challenge, but your opponent suddenly pales and hurries away.
7030014.ch: 你欣然应战，不过来人却突然脸色剧变，匆忙走了。

7030015.en: {call|B|A}, you are often sent by the Elders to the wild on missions, and I'm really worried about your safety. Please take these just in case, {call|B|A}.
7030015.ch: 嘿嘿，{call|B|A}平日多得长老委以重任，闯荡在外，凶险实多，这些都是我的一些心意，请{call|B|A}笑纳。

7030016.en: {call|B|A}, please advise me and guide me to help me improve!
7030016.ch: 希望{call|B|A}日后多多关照关照！

7030017.en: Oh, I forgot. {call|B|A}, you're on too high a level, and these ordinary things won't help you much!
7030017.ch: 啊，对了，{call|B|A}修为深湛，道法高深，当然用不着我这些凡品！

7030018.en: You are walking in the sect territory and come across several Disciples standing on the side and discussing cultivation. They see you and greet you in salute.
7030018.ch: 你在宗门之中经过，遇见几名聚在一起谈论道法修为的弟子。他们看见你，立即肃然起敬。

7030020.en: We are always ready to serve you!

7030021.en: I have always been admiring you, and it's my dream to be your disciple.
7030021.ch: 一向听闻长老威名，真想拜入到长老门下。

7030022.en: I came across this treasure the other day, and I want to give it to you. Please accept it!
7030022.ch: 弟子近日偶得异宝，想呈献长老，长老请万勿推辞！

7030023.en: Your valuable advice and guidance will help me improve!
7030023.ch: 弟子愚钝，日后希望长老多多照顾！

7030024.en: Oh no, I knew these things can be worthless to a master like you!
7030024.ch: 糟糕，这些俗物长老果然看不上眼！

7030025.en: I always hope you could stay here so that I could serve you every day! Now you're leaving, I'm really upset...
7030025.ch: 弟子一直希望长老常在门中，好让我时常伺候！现在长老离开在即，实叫弟子好生不舍…

7030027.en: Even an elite like you can run into dangers in the wild. I came across this the other day, and it heals wounds effectively. Please take it with you just in case.
7030027.ch: 长老虽然修为深厚，但行走在外难免遇到危险。此为弟子昔日偶遇所得，颇有疗伤之功，请长老随身携带，以备万一。

7030028.en: You are walking in the sect territory and overhear two disciples whispering about you.
7030028.ch: 你于宗门之中行走，忽闻二人细语谈论你。

7030029.en: I think the Elder doesn't quite live up to the reputation.

7030030.en: How dare you disrespect the Elder! I'll make you pay for your insolence!
7030030.ch: 你若再对长老再出言不逊，我便教训你！

7030031.en: Hmph, how funny. Did the Elder drug you to win your blind loyalty?
7030031.ch: 哼，实在可笑，长老给你灌迷药了么？竟叫你如此崇拜？

7030032.en: You are the funny one! How many more heroes like the Elder can you name?
7030032.ch: 可笑之至，似长老一般的人物，八荒之中，能有几人？

7030033.en: You wave your sleeve, stirring the air like a thunder, which strikes the two disciples with awe and stops their bickering. The disciple who doubted you kneels down in fear, begging for your mercy, and promises he dare not offend you again.
7030033.ch: 你轻轻一拂袖，附近好像响了一个惊雷，二人原本激烈争论，都忍不住吃惊停下。那名对你颇有微词的弟子知道你出手震慑，竟然跪倒在地，声称以后不敢。

7030034.en: You laugh at the gossips and leave in peace.
7030034.ch: 你根本不在意旁人说长道短，于是转身离去了。

7030035.en: You are so tired after dealing with sect affairs that you lay your head on one arm and fall asleep.
7030035.ch: 处理宗门事务让你身心俱疲，你忍不住卧臂而睡

7030036.en: Sect Leader, you bear such a heavy burden managing all the affairs in the sect!
7030036.ch: 宗门重担全由宗主一肩负担，实在是辛苦了！

7030037.en: An Elder takes off the robe and covers it on you to shield you against the mountain wind.
7030037.ch: 一名长老竟然脱下身上长袍为你盖上，好让你不受山风吹拂。

7030038.en: An Elder sees you contemplating in an unwell condition.
7030038.ch: 一名长老看你似乎若有所思，而且气色不佳。

7030039.en: Sect Leader, you worked too hard and have gotten an ailment. Please allow me to cure you with my humble abilities and restore your health!
7030039.ch: 宗主为宗门劳心劳力，看来身子已抱有微恙，属下冒犯，愿凭修为替宗主扬清激浊，散去全身不适！

7030058.en: Someone slaps you on your back out of a sudden, and since you are focused on the manual in your hands, this slap takes you by surprise and disrupts your Qi to such an extent that you spit out some blood.
7030058.ch: 突然有人朝着你的后背拍一巴掌，你正全神贯注的看着秘籍，这一巴掌直接导致你灵气乱窜，吐了口血出来。

7030059.en: Sorry I slapped you too hard. Are you all right?
7030059.ch: 刚刚拍你未控制住力道，没事吧？

7030060.en: I'm fine. I just lost control of my Qi momentarily.
7030060.ch: 并无大碍，一时灵气不受控制而已。

7030061.en: The Elder tosses a book of Martial Arts to you and says, "You browsed for so long without taking your pick. Just take this one. I don't need it anymore."
7030061.ch: 长老丢出一本功法，并说道：“看你挑选许久，也没看中哪一本，这个你就拿去吧。反正我也用不着了”

7030062.ch: 这位道友，还请手下留人。

7030063.en: Mind your own business, or I'll kill you too!
7030063.ch: 少多管闲事！信不信我连你一起杀！

7030066.en: Huh? You want to peek at my mind to find out my Realm? I can crush a {grade|B} like you with one finger.
7030066.ch: 嗯？还想用神识看我境界？就你这{grade|B}，我动动手指就能捏死你。

7030067.en: You're a {grade|C}! Please spare my life!

7030069.en: {name|B} turns pale as a ghost and runs away in a hurry.
7030069.ch: {name|B}脸色煞白，连滚带爬的逃离了此地。

7030071.en: {name|B}, are you in the mood to drink with me?
7030071.ch: {name|B}，可有闲情逸致，与我小酌一番？

7030072.ch: 今日我带来了我自己酿的酒。

7030073.en: You feel tipsy after two goblets.
7030073.ch: 你刚喝完两杯，就已有些醉意。

7030075.en: Of course! I'm drinking it up first!
7030075.ch: 区区几杯而已，我先干为敬！！

7030077.en: Wake up! Wake up! It's already morning!

7030079.en: I'm taking some good wine with me.
7030079.ch: 今日我带来了寻觅到的好酒。

7030080.en: You chat and drink, and the night is late before you notice.
7030080.ch: 你们一边闲聊，一边饮酒，不知不觉已到深夜。

7030081.en: You have a great time drinking and talking about the old days until dawn.
7030081.ch: 你们饮至深夜，酒杯相碰，畅谈往昔，不觉已到翌日。

7030082.en: I haven't had such a good time drinking for so long!
7030082.ch: 我已许久没有喝得如此尽兴了！

7030083.en: You enjoy alcohol as much as I do. I'm taking a good vintage with me. How about we drink together tonight?
7030083.ch: 阁下也是爱酒之士，今日我带来了珍藏已久的佳酿。今晚一同品尝一番可好？

7030084.en: Night has fallen, and you arrive at the tavern, waiting for {call|B|A}'s arrival.
7030084.ch: 日渐黄昏， 你来到了酒馆，等候着{call|B|A}的到来。

7030085.ch: 我怎么感觉所有东西都在晃……

7030087.en: You really hold your liquor well!

7030088.en: You seem to have run into troubles. Do you need my help with this mission?
7030088.ch: 看来你似乎遇到了些难处，你需要我帮你完成这个任务吗？

7030089.en: That is a hard mission indeed, but I have done it for you. No need to worry about it.
7030089.ch: 任务的确不简单，不过我已经帮你完成了，你就不必再挂记此事。

7030090.en: You are about to express gratitude when {name|B} turns around and leaves, saying "don't mention it!"
7030090.ch: 你正准备开口道谢，{name|B}就已转身离去，只传来一句“你我之间，就不必言谢了。”

7030092.en: {name|A}, it's so good to cultivate with you.

7030094.en: A mount is a must-have to travel in the wild. I got this mount for you. Do you like it?
7030094.ch: 行走八荒，合适的坐骑必不可少，我为你寻到了此坐骑，你看可合心意？

7030095.en: How can a {grade|A} cultivator like you not have a good ring? I got this one for you. Do you want it?
7030095.ch: 我看道友你是{grade|A}，却没有合适的戒指。我为你寻到了一枚戒指，你可需要？

7030096.en: I know a thing or two about your martial art. Let me tell you my understanding.
7030096.ch: 你这功法，我略有涉猎。你且听我讲解。

7030097.en: Modest as he is, your master {name|B} knows everything about this martial art.
7030097.ch: 你的师父{name|B}虽嘴上谦虚，但对功法内容了如指掌。

7030098.ch: 刚刚讲的这些都听懂了吗？

7030099.en: Your master asks you several questions while stroking his chin, and you answer them correctly. Your master nods in approval and praises you, "good student."
7030099.ch: 师父摸了摸下巴，考验了你几个问题，你也都一一答对了。师父点了点头，夸道：“孺子可教也”

7030100.en: I'll teach you again. Try to remember it this time.
7030100.ch: 那我再教你一遍，切记用心体会。

7030101.en: You have finally mastered the manual completely after your master taught you again and again.
7030101.ch: 终于，在师父教了你一遍又一遍后，你将秘籍全部领悟。

7030102.en: {name|C} comes by after hearing you were refused and talks with {name|B} for a long time.
7030102.ch: {name|C}听到你被拒绝后就跑过来，拉着{name|B}叽里呱啦的讲了半天。

7030103.en: I never knew you were so much fun!
7030103.ch: 原来你是这样有趣的人。

7030104.en: How about you try it again?

7030105.en: {name|C} talks with {name|B} for a long time again.

7030106.en: How about you try again? You'll make it work this time!
7030106.ch: 不如再试试？这次定能成功！

7030107.en: Sage Tianbao pulls you over and says, "you have an impressive aura— Arrrgh! Who is hitting me?"
7030107.ch: 天宝真人又将你拉过去，“这位道友气宇轩——啊！谁在打我”

7030108.en: You swindler! How dare you come again!
7030108.ch: 你这臭道士，又来招摇撞骗

7030109.en: Sage Tianbao is just about to lose temper when he turns his head to see the pretty Senior, and he gives a quiet cough instead and says, "I never deceive anyone!"
7030109.ch: 天宝真人正欲发火，却一扭头看到师姐的姣好面容，故作正经咳了咳后开口：“在下可是有真本事的！”

7030110.en: Your senior takes your hand to leave, saying, "don't tell me!"
7030110.ch: 师姐拉着你就走了，只丢下一句“哼！谁信？”

7030125.en: {call|B|A}, are you going to throw these things away? Could you give this garbage... no... used treasures to me?
7030125.ch: {call|B|A}，这些东西你都准备不要么！可不可以将这些垃圾……不……废宝都给我？

7030126.en: This {callB|A} picks up what you just discarded and leaves happy and satisfied.
7030126.ch: 这名{callB|A}捧起你丢掉的东西喜滋滋的离开了。

7030127.en: {call|B|A}, I've been studying Advanced Alchemy, a Secret Technique, to make special elixirs, and the things you just threw away can be useful to me!
7030127.ch: {call|B|A}，我最近在参研一部秘术《上仙丹诰》来炼制特殊丹药，而你扔掉的东西正好派上用场！

7030128.en: {call|B|A}, do you remember me? I made three Elixirs with what you discarded, so I think you deserve to have one of them!
7030128.ch: {call|B|A}，你还记得我么？我拿了你的东西炼成丹药三枚，这些丹药有{call|B|A}你的东西在里面，怎么也得给你服下一丸强身健体！

7030129.en: After taking the elixir, a colic strikes you in the abdomen. After you finally recover from the pain, you feel your body refreshed and your EXP increased.
7030129.ch: 使用丹药之后，你腹中绞痛，辛苦难当，经历一阵折磨，终于平复，尽管身体仍然有点难受，但你分明感觉体内污浊一空，修为由此增长。

7030130.en: After taking the elixir, you feel a cool air flowing through your veins smoothly like dewdrops.
7030130.ch: 使用丹药之后，你感觉全身升起一股清凉之感，气息仿如粒粒凝珠，于体内诸脉通行无阻。

7030132.en: I know, you don't want to give these used treasures to me to protect me from harm!
7030132.ch: 我知道的，{call|A|B}你不给我都是因为怕这些废宝于我有害！

7030135.en: Then this {call|A|B} picks up what you just discarded and leaves happy and satisfied.
7030135.ch: 这名{call|A|B}说完后，捧起你丢掉的东西喜滋滋的离开了。

7030136.en: Then this {call|A|B} stuffs the elixir into your hands and leaves in a hurry.
7030136.ch: 这名{call|A|B}说完，二话不说将丹药塞到你手上，转头就离开了。

7030137.en: I heard you teamed with Hou Yi to slay the Three-legged Crow that wreaked havoc in Yong Ning. Is it true?
7030137.ch: {call|B|A}，听说当年造成永宁州赤地千里，生灵涂炭的妖物三足乌，乃是由你与英雄后羿合力击杀的，这是真的么？

7030139.en: After you admit it, several Initiates appear nearby and cast looks of admiration to you.
7030139.ch: 你直承其事后，周围突然出现几名外门弟子，他们对你纷纷投以尊敬的目光。

7030140.en: So it's not you? Well, I always wanted to meet that hero in person! What a pity!
7030140.ch: 不是{call|B|A}么？原来是传闻失实！唉，我真盼能一见当时与后羿收拾三足乌，拯救八荒大地的英雄啊！

7030141.en: Disappointed, this person leaves after saying goodbye to you.
7030141.ch: 此人神情颇为失望，跟你道别后转头去了。

7030142.en: I don't understand why you would ask the Junior about the Heaven-chosen. Why ask her when I'm here on your side? Just ask me!
7030142.ch: 我对于{call|B|A}你请教小师妹“何为天骄”这个问题感到十分费解。为什么还要询问小师妹呢？我与{call|B|A}你近在咫尺，若要了解，只管问我，如何？

7030143.en: The bandit leader may be tough, but still only a local bandit. It would be a waste of your time, Sect Leader! Please send me to finish the enemy off!
7030143.ch: 匪首虽强，不过州中宵小，何劳宗主出手？弟子请宗主允许我出手将此獠捉拿正法！

7030144.en: This Disciple went on the mission once you approved. He returned shortly afterward.
7030144.ch: 此名弟子得你允许之后，马上出发。没想到不过片刻功夫他便已经回来。

7030145.en: Sect Leader, I defeated the bandit leader!
7030145.ch: 禀告宗主，匪首已为弟子击败！

7030146.en: It's not my place to advise you! Please forgive me!
7030146.ch: 是弟子僭越了！盼望宗主赎罪！

7030147.en: Sect Leader, it would be a waste of your time to deal with this scum by yourself. Just leave it to me, and I'll try my best to save you the trouble.
7030147.ch: 宗主万金之躯，何必与这名素与我宗作对的小人斤斤计较？只交给属下出手击杀此人即可。若是属下不敌，那时再请宗主收拾此人不迟。

7030148.en: Yes, Sect Leader! I will finish the enemy off at once!
7030148.ch: 属下得令，请宗主稍待，我马上出去将此人击杀！

7030149.en: The Elder bowed to you and left in a hurry. Shortly afterward, {gender|B} is back.
7030149.ch: 长老对你稍一行礼，便即转身离去，不过片刻之后，{gender|B}便已经潇洒回来。

7030150.en: Sect Leader, I have slain the enemy and defended the glory of our Sect!
7030150.ch: 禀报宗主，宗门敌人已为属下亲手格杀，此行总算没有辜负宗主信任！

7030151.en: I'm to blame. The enemy is too strong and sly for me to kill.
7030151.ch: 属下知错了。此人实力强大、阴险狡诈，原非属下能够轻易击杀！

7030152.en: Sect Leader, please send me instead to rescue the captured Disciple!
7030152.ch: 属下斗胆，请宗主稳坐门中，便待属下去将失陷弟子救回便好！

7030153.en: I will accomplish the mission and rescue the Disciple.
7030153.ch: 宗主委以重托，属下定必竭尽全力，将弟子救回。

7030154.en: At your nod, this member left in a hurry. Shortly afterward, he is back.
7030154.ch: 你稍一点头，此名门人头也不回的去了。但不过片刻功夫他便已经转回。

7030155.en: I accomplished the mission and rescued the Disciple!
7030155.ch: 属下不辱使命，已将那名弟子救回！

7030156.en: Sect Leader, you've always been concerned about the captured Disciple, and that's why I respect you.
7030156.ch: 宗主始终心系失陷弟子，真叫属下佩服。

7030157.en: The External Affairs Traitor is a tough enemy lurking in our Sect for a long time. You have only recently joined our Sect and are still unfamiliar with our affairs. It would be too much of a challenge for you to finish off this traitor. How about I carry out the mission in your stead?
7030157.ch: {call|B|A}，外务堂内奸潜藏我宗已久，实力不弱。你入门时日尚浅，门中许多事务仍未熟习，此时让你前往击杀外务堂内奸未免为难，就让我来帮你完成这个任务如何？

7030158.en: Please wait here. I'll be back in a minute.

7030159.en: This {call|A|B} said goodbye to you and leaved in a hurry. Shortly afterward, he is back here.
7030159.ch: 这位{call|A|B}向你作别，一下去远。不过他去了没多久就即转回。

7030160.en: I have captured the External Affairs Traitor.
7030160.ch: {call|B|A}，我已经成功将外务堂内奸抓回。

7030161.en: If you insist, I won't stop you. Take these elixirs with you just in case.
7030161.ch: {call|B|A}既执意亲自前往，我也不好强求。这里有几枚丹药，便请师弟带上防身。

7030162.en: The monster is savage and tough to handle. You are new in the Sect and have not fully mastered the skills. It would be too dangerous for you to deal with it. How about I hunt this monster in your stead?
7030162.ch: {call|B|A}，怪物穷凶极恶，不易应付。而你作为门中新人，道法并未熟练，此行稍不留神，恐怕会出意外。要么让我替你出手将肆虐的妖物剿灭如何？

7030163.en: Please wait here. I'll finish off the monster and come back soon.
7030163.ch: 请{call|B|A}稍等，我将妖物扫灭，去去即回。

7030166.en: If you insist, I won't say anything more.
7030166.ch: {call|B|A}既执意亲自前往，我也不多事了。

7030167.en: You're in a slight disadvantage in the duel, and you hear a faint sound at your ears.
7030167.ch: 你于比斗之中略处下风，正在此时，你耳边传来一丝微响。

7030168.en: This is a duel you can't lose. I'll thrust some power into your body to boost your strength for a short time. You're the most promising one among all the Disciples, and I hope you will turn the tide of the duel and defeat the opponent.
7030168.ch: 此战许胜不许败，本座现今将一道罡气隔空打入你体内，暂时增长你的修为。诸弟子中，本座对你抱以极大期盼，希望你由此反败为胜，一举击败对手

7030169.en: The Disciple is at a disadvantage in the duel and will shortly be overwhelmed. You decide to...
7030169.ch: 场上弟子已于比斗之中落在下风，看来胜负已经分出，你要……

7030170.en: You thrust some power into the Disciple's body from the distance.
7030170.ch: 你将一道罡气隔空打入场上弟子体内。

7030171.en: What? I feel a flow of energy through my veins. What is that?
7030171.ch: 啊？我突然间全身激流遍涌，这是怎么回事？

7030172.en: Damn it, the opponent is too strong. I'll let the Sect Leader down!
7030172.ch: 可恶，对手太强，这次只怕要辜负宗主对我的期望了！

7030173.en: Sect Leader, please don't lose heart! Though we failed, we still have our foundation intact. As long as we work hard together, we will one day have our revenge!
7030173.ch: 宗主不必气馁，此战虽败，但门内根基仍在，只需日后齐心协力，总有一天能够覆灭敌方宗门！

7030174.en: Some Disciples overheard your talk with the Elders and walked over to you. They gather around you and express their wish to follow you to restore the Sect after the defeat.
7030174.ch: 部分弟子听到你与长老之间的谈话，都走了上来。他们簇拥着你表示此战虽败，仍然愿意追随你左右，为光大宗门尽一番力。

7040001.en: Yeah, it's so tasty. I like it.

7040002.en: Well, I won't say no to this.
7040002.ch: 既是此物，老夫便却之不恭了。

7040003.en: I enjoyed the food so much!

7040005.en: I ate too much and can barely walk. That's it.
7040005.ch: 吃得太多，行动都不便了，罢了罢了。

7040006.en: I ate too much and can't take one more bite.
7040006.ch: 老夫饮食过多，着实吃不下了。

7040007.en: I feel so disturbed lately. I wonder why...
7040007.ch: 近日莫名愁绪颇多，却也不知为何……

7040008.en: Alas, why am I in such a fret...

7040009.en: I feel so good lately. What do you seek me for?
7040009.ch: 近日心情大好，小友找老夫何事？

7040010.en: You come to play with me?
7040010.ch: 莫非来与老夫嬉戏一番？

7040011.en: I feel depressed. Please leave me alone.
7040011.ch: 老夫心中阻塞，小友勿要相扰。

7040015.en: You sent me a lot food lately. I came across this the other day, and I want you to have it.
7040015.ch: 近日老夫偶有所得，看在你多有送饭的份上，便将其赠予小友。

7040016.en: I'm having a lot of new understandings lately. I'll share some Destiny with you if you can bring me more food in the future.
7040016.ch: 老夫有所感悟，便赐予小友一番气运，日后你可要多带些美食给我。

7040017.en: We are old friends now. I came across this Destiny lately, and I want to give it to you.
7040017.ch: 你我交心多时，老夫有一番气运，便将其赐予小友了。

7040018.en: Glad to see you here. Perhaps you've already noticed this new finding. It's yours now.
7040018.ch: 来得正好，老夫正小有所获，怕是你我时常谈心，已然觉察？罢了，此物便赠予你了。

7050001.en: {callSchool|A} has made so much progress and reached {currentArea|A} at such a young age. What a genius!
7050001.ch: {callSchool|A}修为有成，如此年纪便踏入{currentArea|A}，实在是同辈翘楚、人中龙凤。

7050002.en: We {schoolName|A} have long established us here, and {callSchool|A} is our branch. If you want to join us, you don't need to take the test, and you can inherit a post up to the Disciple.
7050002.ch: 我{schoolName|A}在此地颇有根基，{callSchool|A}作为下宗故人，若能前来加入，不仅可免试入宗，还能最高继承到内门弟子的宗门职位。

7050003.en: This is a pass issued by our {schoolName|A}. {callSchool|A}, take this to our sect, and you'll see what is waiting for you.
7050003.ch: 此处有一张我{schoolName|A}的通行令，{callSchool|A}持此物前来宗门，自知其中分晓。

7050004.en: I'll wait for you in the sect, {callSchool|A}. See you!
7050004.ch: 希望能尽早在宗门内见到，{callSchool|A}。那么，下次再见！

7050005.en: {callSchool|A}, you're here! I knew you would come!
7050005.ch: {callSchool|A}果然前来，不愧是师妹看好之人！

7050006.en: {callSchool|A}, our Elders have told me, several times, that you can join our sect without a test. And I'm given the task to explain post inheritance to you.
7050006.ch: 我宗长老已然再三嘱咐，若{callSchool|A}前来入宗，直接免试，并令我向你说明职位继承之事。

7050007.en: There is this rule in the sect. If a Branch Disciple whose position in the branch was Disciple or lower joins the sect, they keep the same position.
7050007.ch: 宗门定有规矩，若分舵弟子在拜入时，其于分舵的职位低于或就是内门弟子，则保持其职位不变。

7050008.en: If their position in the branch was higher than Disciple, they start from the position of Disciple after joining our sect.
7050008.ch: 若其于分舵的身份高于内门弟子，则在拜入我宗后将强制定为内门弟子。

7050009.en: This rule was made to ensure fair competition among the disciples, build a harmonious cultivation environment, and avoid conflicts. Hope you will understand.
7050009.ch: 此举是为了使宗门内弟子公平竞争，营造良好的修炼氛围，不至引发矛盾，还望{callSchool|A}理解。

7050010.en: I wish you will enjoy the cultivation in our sect!
7050010.ch: 那么，祝{callSchool|A}在宗门内一切顺利，修行之路坦荡无阻！

7050011.en: Sect Leader, you have made a breakthrough into the realm of {currentArea|A}. You must want to go on the new journey with your old sect.
7050011.ch: 宗主大人，您境界突破，踏入{currentArea|A}，想必也不舍宗门众人的陪伴。

7050012.en: If you can build a Sect Flying Canoe and plant the Relocation Flag here, you can relocate the sect here to grow with it.
7050012.ch: 若您能够修建宗门飞舟，并于此地成功埋下定岳旗，便可将宗门搬迁至此，继续您的宗门发展之路。

7050013.en: For more details, please check the Sect Council Hall.
7050013.ch: 具体事宜，还请您前往宗门议事大厅中查看。

7050014.en: May {school|A} grow into the number one sect across the world under your leadership!
7050014.ch: 那么，愿我{school|A}在您的统领下成为八荒第一大宗！

7050015.en: {callSchool|A}, you have made a breakthrough into the realm of {currentArea|A}. You must want to go on the new journey with your old sect.
7050015.ch: {callSchool|A}，您境界突破，踏入{currentArea|A}，想必也不舍宗门众人的陪伴。

7050016.en: If you become the Sect Leader, you can relocate the sect here.
7050016.ch: 若{callSchool|A}能够成为宗主，便可发动宗门搬迁，将宗门迁移至此地。

7050017.en: Have you ever thought about it?

7050018.en: If you want to join a new sect, you need to return to your old sect and apply to leave first, but is that really what you want to do?
7050018.ch: 若想另寻宗门加入，则需要先返回宗门并申请退宗，不过{callSchool|A}真会如此狠心吗？

7050019.en: Whatever choice you will make, I wish you all well in your future cultivation!
7050019.ch: 无论{callSchool|A}如何选择，小师妹都祝愿{callSchool|A}修行之路一帆风顺！

7050020.en: The Relocation Flag has been planted. Return to your sect and make necessary preparations to relocate your sect here.
7050020.ch: 定岳旗已经埋下，回到宗门做好准备后就可以将宗门搬迁到此处。

7050021.en: Congratulations! You're now officially our Sect Leader!
7050021.ch: 恭喜，自今日起你正式成为本宗宗主了！

7050022.en: After you leave the sect, your pass flies out of your bag and vanishes into thin air.
7050022.ch: 你从宗门退出后，通行令牌从背包中飞出并逐渐消失。

7060301.en: I'm counting on you for the Sect Competition next month.
7060301.ch: 下个月的宗门大比，我很看好你。

7060303.en: Take this Artifact and use it well!

7060304.en: You should give it your all in the coming Sect Competition and fight for the first place.
7060304.ch: 徒儿，此次宗门大比，你可要得用尽毕生所学，争取赢个魁首回来。

7060306.en: I procured this Manual for you. It will help with your Martial Arts.
7060306.ch: 这本秘籍，是为师专门为你搜来的好功法。

7060307.en: The coming Sect Competition is a very important event for us. If you can stand out amongst the competitors, it'll give me a chance to praise you in front of the Sect Leader to secure an earlier promotion for you.
7060307.ch: 此次大比，事关重大。你若能有突出表现，我也好帮你在宗主面前多美言几句，争取早日职位晋升。

7060308.en: {name|A}, I've always known you're a genius. I'm confident you'll stand out in this competition. Take this and fight well.
7060308.ch: {name|A}，我一向觉得你天赋异禀，相信你定能在本次大比中大放光彩。此物是对你的鼓励。

7060309.en: I can help you get admitted in the coming Sect Competition. What do you say? If that's what you want, I'll recommend you to the Sect Leader.
7060309.ch: 我想替你争取参加这次宗门大比的机会，你可愿意？你若想试试，我便去向宗主提议。

7060310.en: After thorough consideration, the Sect Leader decides to send you to the competition.
7060310.ch: 经过宗主的深思熟虑，决定由你参加大比。

7060311.en: I'm really sorry, but the Sect Leader turned down your application to join the Sect Competition.
7060311.ch: 我感到非常遗憾，你来当大比替补弟子这件事宗主拒绝了。

7060312.en: I've heard you'll participate in the Sect Competition, and I'll cheer for you! I hope this can be helpful to you.
7060312.ch: 听说你即将参加宗门大比，我会在台下为你加油的！这希望可以派上用场。

7060313.en: I've heard you'll participate in the Sect Competition. I'm really looking forward to your performance! I hope this can be helpful to you.
7060313.ch: 听说你即将参加宗门大比，希望你可以取得好成绩，这希望可以派上用场。

7060314.en: We'll both participate in the Sect Competition. How about we have a spar for practice?
7060314.ch: 这次我们都将参加宗门大比，不如来场切磋，提前练习练习？

7060315.en: I participated in the Sect Competition before. It's a gathering of elites all over the world! You have to give it your all.
7060315.ch: 我曾经参加过宗门大比，那可是高手如云。到时你有什么看家本领都使出来，不必藏着掖着。

7060316.en: You in Sect Competition? How about you quit now to save your face?
7060316.ch: 你也配参加宗门大比？早些自己退赛吧，免得丢人现眼。

7060317.en: Hah! I wonder what made you think you could participate in the Sect Competition.
7060317.ch: 呵！真不明白凭什么是你参加宗门大比？

7060318.en: With your Realm, you'll be beaten to the ground before you know it.
7060318.ch: 你这种境界参加大比，小心到时上场了，几息就被打倒在地。

7060319.en: With your Realm, you're allowed into the Sect Competition? I've brought it up to the Sect Leader. You just wait. I'll replace you!
7060319.ch: 你这境界也能参加大比？我已向宗主禀告此事了，等着吧，参加大比的人肯定是我！

7060320.en: Hah! You're good, aren't you? Even I can't replace you!
7060320.ch: 呵！你可真是好手段，居然连我都替代不了你。

7060321.en: You don't need to prepare for the Sect Competition anymore. Just rest.
7060321.ch: 从今天起，你就不必准备宗门大比了，好生歇着吧。

7060322.en: I think I'm much stronger than {name|C}. Sect Leader, why don't you consider sending me to the Sect Competition?
7060322.ch: 我自诩实力远超{name|C}，宗主为何不考虑考虑让我出战？

7060323.en: It's such a privilege! Thank you, Sect Leader! Please accept this as a small token of my gratitude.
7060323.ch: 多谢宗主给我这个机会，我不胜感激！此物是弟子的一点小心意，敬请笑纳。

7060324.en: Sect Leader, {name|C} has done so much evil and is really not a good choice to fight for our sect in the Sect Competition. You see, I have already reached {grade|B} Realm. How about you send me instead of {name|C}?
7060324.ch: 宗主您有所不知，{name|C}作恶多端，实在不是参加大比的合适人选。况且我已{grade|B}，不如让我代替{name|C}参加宗门大比，您觉得如何？

7060325.en: I have made my decision, and it's settled.
7060325.ch: 我意已决，此事不必再议。

7060326.en: Thank you for your approval. I'll give it my all in the competition! Please accept this as a small token of my gratitude.
7060326.ch: 多谢宗主的认可，这次大比我定不辱使命！此物是弟子的一点小心意，还望宗主收下。

7060328.en: Sect Leader, I think {0} is too weak and vile to participate in the competition. {1} may not be a True Disciple, but has reached a higher Realm than {0}. How about you send {1} to the competition instead?
7060328.ch: 宗主，我认为{0}实力不足，为人卑劣，不应参加大比。而{1}虽然不是真传，但境界高于{0}，您看不如让{1}参加可好？

7060329.en: I've heard Elders would seek Treasures for their Disciples during the Sect Competition. Could you get one for me when it begins?
7060329.ch: 听闻宗门大比时，长老会为参比弟子寻找秘宝，到时长老可否让我感受一番这秘宝的威力？

7060330.en: Thank you for taking care of me! Please accept this as a small token of my gratitude.
7060330.ch: 多谢{call|B|A}的照顾!这是弟子的一点心意，还望您不要拒绝。

7060331.en: I've heard you and {0} are on bad terms, and I always think {0} is not a person of integrity. Do you think I could be a better candidate? Could you please recommend me to the Sect Leader?
7060331.ch: 听闻您{0}与曾有不合，我也一直认为{0}德不配位，您看不如由我出战大比可好？不知您是否愿意向宗主提议此事？

7060333.en: You gave me the chance to fight in the Sect Competition, and it's your trust that motivated me on my way to win the first place! Please accept this as a small token of my gratitude.
7060333.ch: 若不是宗主提携，我也无缘本次宗门大比，此次获得魁首也算是对得起宗主的栽培！此物略表心意，不成敬礼。

7060334.en: Our Disciple won the first place, and it's your hard work and wisdom in leading this sect that made it happen!
7060334.ch: 我宗获得头筹佳绩，宗主真是英明神武、治理有方！

7060335.en: The Sect Competition has finished, and our Disciple won the first place! I've found a place with beautiful scenery nearby. How about we go there for a walk and relax?
7060335.ch: 宗门大比终于落下帷幕了，我宗还摘得了头筹！我在附近寻到一处美景佳处，不如我们去散散心？

7060336.en: I was once only an ordinary Disciple in the sect, and I was tentative when I asked the Sect Leader to send me to the Sect Competition, but the Sect Leader trusted me and gave me this chance.
7060336.ch: 曾经我也不过只是宗门的普通弟子，不过抱着试一试的心态请求宗主让我参加宗门大比，没有料到宗主居然给我了这个机会。

7060337.en: Now I'm a Grand Elder, but that moving moment has never slipped my memory. Today I want to thank you again for all that you've done for me! I will work hard to live up to the position of Grand Elder!
7060337.ch: 如今，我已晋升大长老，但心中仍铭记着当初的感动，今日，只想再次向宗主道谢！此物是感谢宗主的栽培，日后的大长老生涯，我也会尽心尽力！

7060338.en: Thanks to your Treasure, I gained the upper hand in the Open Challenge Match!
7060338.ch: 多亏了长老的秘宝，在擂台赛时为我争取到了极大的优势！

7060339.en: I thought I could put up a good fight this time, but I failed. Master, am I really that bad?
7060339.ch: 我本以为这次大比我会大放光彩，可是，我却拖了后腿。师父，我真的有这么差吗？

7060340.en: I see. I'll work harder in the future!
7060340.ch: 师父，我明白了，日后我会更加努力的修炼的！

7060342.en: I won the first place in the Sect Competition! Weren't you always so arrogant? You can only bully the weak in the sect?
7060342.ch: 这次大比的魁首可是我哦！你不是平时挺嚣张的吗，怎么该嚣张的时候却息声了？

7060343.en: {name|A}, you were really amazing in the Sect Competition!
7060343.ch: {name|A}，你在这次宗门大比上真是大放异彩！

7060344.en: {name|A}, you were shining like a star when fighting in the Sect Competition!
7060344.ch: {name|A}，参加宗门大比时候的你，就像那白昼流星般耀眼夺目。

7060345.en: I never knew you could be so good! Please take this treasure as my congratulation gift. I hope you could perhaps watch my back in the future.
7060345.ch: 没想到你竟然如此厉害！此物是在下珍藏已久的宝物，如今献给你，还望阁下日后能对我多加照应。

7060346.en: I'm really sorry for refusing your request to be my Partner when I knew you so little. Your performance in the Sect Competition was so impressive.
7060346.ch: 先前你向我请求结缘，那时我对你还了解尚浅，因此拒绝了。此次宗门大比，你竟表现的如此亮眼，真是让我耳目一新。

7060347.en: I could have never imagined an ordinary cultivator like you could make such a great achievement. I underestimated you when I attacked you the other day!
7060347.ch: 想不到你不过一介普通修仙者，也能如此厉害。看来当初贸然攻击你，是我轻敌了！

7060348.en: The next Sect Competition will be held in three years. There is enough time to prepare!
7060348.ch: 下一次宗门大比会在三年后举行，接下来有很长一段时间可以进行准备了！

7060401.en: The war is over, and our sect won a decisive victory! Now is the time to distribute rewards!
7060401.ch: 此次大战结束，我宗大获全胜！现在开始论功行赏！

7060402.en: All the rewards have been distributed. You must all be tired. Please go back to your sect and have a good rest.
7060402.ch: 奖励已颁发完毕，想必经此一战诸位已非常疲惫，请回到宗门好好修养吧。

7060411.en: First, we are presenting the Sect Wargod prize for the most gallant Disciple in this war.
7060411.ch: 首先，要给此次大战中最为英勇善战的弟子，颁发宗门战神奖！

7060412.en: In this war, <r>{0}</r> mowed down all resistance and killed {2} enemies!
7060412.ch: 在大战中，<r>{0}</r>所向披靡、无往不胜，宛如破军星降世，击杀了{2}名敌人！

7060413.en: The Sect Wargod prize goes to <r>{0}</r> without question! Next is the Guardian Slayer prize.
7060413.ch: 这宗门战神奖，<r>{0}</r>实至名归！接下来，颁发屠兽英雄奖。

7060414.en: <r>{0}</r> fought bravely against the Guardian of the enemy sect and dealt {3} damage to it in total, paving the way for our victory!
7060414.ch: 面对敌宗神兽，<r>{0}</r>毫不畏惧、奋勇当先，累计对其造成了{3}伤害，为我宗争取了极大的优势！

7060415.en: Let's congratulate <r>{0}</r> for winning the Guardian Slayer prize!
7060415.ch: 让我们恭喜<r>{0}</r>获得屠兽英雄奖！

7060416.en: To know how to stay alive on the battlefield is also an important skill. Finally, we are presenting the Calm and Steady prize.
7060416.ch: 战场上，如何保命亦是一门学问。最后，要颁发的是沉着冷静奖。

7060417.en: <r>{0}</r> showed a perfect balance of bravery and caution, and was only heavily wounded {4} times! A perfect example of composure leading to success on the battlefield.
7060417.ch: <r>{0}</r>在这次大战中胆大心细，仅被重伤{4}次！向我们完美地演绎了如何在战场上冷静思考、沉着应对。

7060418.en: This Calm and Steady prize goes to <r>{0}</r>! Now that this Sect War has finished, every participant Disciple will receive their rewards!
7060418.ch: 这沉着冷静奖是属于<r>{0}</r>的荣耀！至此，本次宗门大战圆满结束，所有出战弟子都将获得奖励！

7060419.en: <r>{0}</r> showed a perfect balance of bravery and caution, and was not heavily wounded even once! A perfect example of composure leading to success on the battlefield.
7060419.ch: <r>{0}</r>在这次大战中胆大心细，全程未曾重伤！向我们完美地演绎了如何在战场上冷静思考、沉着应对。

7060421.en: Today I ran into an enemy Disciple who looked like an elite but turned out not a big deal! Haha!
7060421.ch: 今天碰到一个敌方的大能，我还以为多厉害，结果发现就是纸老虎罢了，哈哈！

7060422.en: I made great progress in this war. It takes real battles to perfect my moves!
7060422.ch: 此次一战我修为大有长进，看来平日练的招式还是得多实战才行！

7060423.en: I've used up all my Artifacts. I need to forge some more.
7060423.ch: 之前搜罗来的法宝都损耗完了，看来还得再去炼制几个。

7060424.en: I never knew <r>{5}</r> was so strong! I'll try to get on good terms with this person.
7060424.ch: 没想到<r>{5}</r>居然如此厉害！我日后定要与此人多多结交。

7060425.en: Luckily, I learned this Motion Skill before the war. It saved my life!
7060425.ch: 还好我大战前临时学了一门身法，临危之际逃命实在好用！

7060426.en: <r>{5}</r>, what was the Ultimate Skill you unleashed on the battleground today? It was impressive! Could you teach me that?
7060426.ch: <r>{5}</r>你今日在场上放的神通叫什么，太厉害了！能教教我吗?

7060427.en: <r>{5}</r>, your Tao is impressive. You are one of the best in our sect!
7060427.ch: <r>{5}</r>你道法非凡，不愧是我宗翘楚！

7060428.en: I'm in perfect condition today! Nothing can stop me from winning the Sect Wargod prize!
7060428.ch: 我今天状态极好！感觉自己简直所向披靡，宗门战神奖肯定就是我了！

7060429.en: We did a great job today. What rewards will we get...
7060429.ch: 今天大家发挥的如此好，不知道能发什么奖励呢……

7060430.en: After the award ceremony is over, I'll go back to the sect and have a good rest!
7060430.ch: 等颁奖结束了，我一定要好好回宗门休养一番！

7060431.en: Today I saved the person I've always cared about. I wonder if this person will treat me differently in the future?
7060431.ch: 今日救了我心仪之人一命，不知道此人会不会因此对我高看一眼呢。

7060442.en: I once met <r>{0}</r> on the battlefield. This person leaves no creatures alive in the wake!
7060442.ch: 我在场上遇到过<r>{0}</r>，此人所到之处，简直寸草不生！

7060443.en: The big names are supposedly aloof from everyone else. I wonder if <r>{0}</r> wants to be my friend.
7060443.ch: 听说高手都很孤僻，不知道<r>{0}</r>会不会愿意同我结交。

7060444.en: When can I be a big name like <r>{0}</r>!
7060444.ch: 什么时候我才能成为像<r>{0}</r>这样的高手呀！

7060445.en: <r>{0}</r>! You're the strongest cultivator all over the world!

7060446.en: What! I didn't get the prize?
7060446.ch: 震惊！获奖之人竟然不是我！

7060447.en: I knew <r>{0}</r> was somebody, but I could have never imagined this person is a world-class cultivator!
7060447.ch: 本以为<r>{0}</r>是个高手，没想到居然是绝世高手！

7060448.en: I want to follow you in cultivation, <r>{0}</r>! Could you be my sworn sibling?
7060448.ch: 我日后要追随你！<r>{0}</r>，改日我们结义可好？

7060449.en: I want to practice <r>{0}</r>'s Martial Arts too!!
7060449.ch: 我也要去练<r>{0}</r>所用的功法！！

7060450.en: You can't imagine how brilliant and stunning <r>{0}</r> was on the battlefield!
7060450.ch: 你们有所不知，<r>{0}</r>在战斗时简直熠熠生辉、光彩夺目！

7060461.en: Our Sect Leader is so generous! I'm so lucky to join this sect!!
7060461.ch: 宗主大人也太慷慨了！终身不悔入我宗！！

7060462.en: It's my honor to join a sect with such a generous Sect Leader!
7060462.ch: 遇到这般好的宗主，实在是我三生有幸。

7060463.en: This is the {6} I've always wanted! I'm so lucky!
7060463.ch: 居然有我钟意已久的{6}，幸哉幸哉！

7060464.en: No other sect can be so generous like ours! I'll do some show-off out there!
7060464.ch: 想必没有任何一个宗门能像我宗一样阔气，我可得出去好好炫耀一番！

7060465.en: What rewards did you guys get? I'm curious!
7060465.ch: 你们都是些什么奖励？讲出来听听可好？

7060466.en: Thank you, Sect Leader! I will serve you whole-heartedly!
7060466.ch: 多谢宗主！在下愿做牛做马，效忠宗主大人！

7060467.en: {6} is not of much use to me. Would you like to trade with me?
7060467.ch: {6}于我而言并无大用，道友，你可愿与我交换？

7060468.ch: 你竟然得到了{6}，在下好生羡慕！

7060471.en: Thank you, Sect Leader! It's your guidance that made us what we are today!
7060471.ch: 多谢宗主！都是宗主栽培有方！

7060472.en: Thank you, Sect Leader! I will continue to serve the sect whole-heartedly!
7060472.ch: 谢宗主！我日后必会继续努力为宗门肝脑涂地！

7060473.en: Thank you, Sect Leader! Thanks to other Disciples' help, I had the chance to perform on stage!
7060473.ch: 谢宗主！这要多亏其他弟子们的协助，我才有机会展现风采！

7060481.en: Our sect has consumed too many resources and find ourselves in a disadvantage! We must fight the enemy with caution and save some of our strengths, or our sect will be doomed!
7060481.ch: 我方宗门资源消耗过多，已然陷入劣势！我宗弟子务必谨慎对敌，适当保存实力，否则宗门不保！

7060482.en: Our sect has used up all the resources and is doomed to fail!
7060482.ch: 我方宗门资源已然全数耗尽，大势已去，我等已无力回天！

7060483.en: Our sect has consumed too many resources and find ourselves in a disadvantage! We must fight the enemy with caution and save some of our strengths, or we'll never breach enemy defense!
7060483.ch: 我方宗门资源消耗过多，已然陷入劣势！我宗弟子务必谨慎对敌，适当保存实力，否则将难以攻入敌宗！

7060484.en: Our sect has used up all the resources and cannot continue to fight!
7060484.ch: 我方宗门资源已然全数耗尽，眼看是无法再战了！

7060491.en: The enemy sect has used up all its resources, and we win the war!
7060491.ch: 来犯宗门的资源已然消耗殆尽，我方大获全胜！

7060501.en: The Sect Wargod prize goes to <r>{0}</r> without question! Next is the Calm and Steady prize.
7060501.ch: 这宗门战神奖，<r>{0}</r>实至名归！接下来，颁发沉着冷静奖。

7060511.en: {callSchool|A}, our sect has emerged victorious in battle after battle, and the enemy sect has been routed. Now that our Sect Leader has decided what to do with them, we can go back to our sect fully loaded with loot.
7060511.ch: {callSchool|A}，我宗连战连胜，所向披靡，已然将敌方宗门完全击溃，如今宗主对于如何处置对方已有决断，我等可满载而归了。

7060512.en: Today we <r>{0}</r> will surely rout <r>{1}</r> and secure victory!
7060512.ch: 我<r>{0}</r>今日出征，必将旗开得胜、一举消灭<r>{1}</r>！

7060521.en: <r>{0}</r> is about to invade our <r>{1}</r>. Let's join our forces and make this place their grave!
7060521.ch: <r>{0}</r>即将入侵我<r>{1}</r>，我等齐心合力，必叫他们有来无回！

7060541.en: How dare those <r>{0}</r> wretches attack our subsidiary <r>{1}</r>! We can't just let it go. {callSchool|A}, please tell us what to do!
7060541.ch: <r>{0}</r>的鼠辈真是胆大包天，竟敢对我宗下属的<r>{1}</r>出手！此事关系重大，还请掌门{callSchool|A}尽早定夺！

7060561.en: {callSchool|A}, <r>{0}</r> who declared the war against us has been wiped out. That's what they deserve to be our enemy!
7060561.ch: {callSchool|A}，叫嚣着要攻打我宗的<r>{0}</r>已被抹灭，怕是再也无法如愿了。把心思打到我宗头上，我看他们也是咎由自取！

7060562.en: Sect Leader, today we <r>{0}</r> will surely rout <r>{1}</r> and secure victory!
7060562.ch: 宗主大人，我<r>{0}</r>今日出征，必将旗开得胜、一举消灭<r>{1}</r>！

7060563.en: Sect Leader, <r>{0}</r> is about to invade our <r>{1}</r>. Let's join our forces and make this place their grave!
7060563.ch: 宗主大人，<r>{0}</r>即将入侵我<r>{1}</r>，我等齐心合力，必叫他们有来无回！

7060564.en: Sect Leader, I won't let you down!

7060565.ch: （八荒山海中又是一场腥风血雨……）

7060566.en: Thanks to your leadership, Sect Leader, we wiped out <r>{1}</r> with our joint efforts and secured peace for our Sect!
7060566.ch: 托宗主洪福，弟子与一众同门齐心合力，已将<r>{1}</r>彻底抹灭，以绝后患！

7060567.en: Thanks to your leadership, Sect Leader, we routed <r>{1}</r> with our joint efforts and plundered all their resources!
7060567.ch: 托宗主洪福，弟子与一众同门齐心合力，已将<r>{1}</r>彻底击溃，并将其宗内的资源洗劫一空！

7060568.en: I was not strong enough and failed to capture <r>{1}</r>. Please punish me for my failure!
7060568.ch: 弟子修为不济，没能攻下<r>{1}</r>，实在罪该万死，还请宗主大人责罚！

7060569.en: Thanks to your leadership, Sect Leader, we repelled the invading <r>{0}</r> and defended our Sect!
7060569.ch: 托宗主洪福，弟子与一众同门齐心合力，成功击退了来犯的<r>{0}</r>，守护住了宗门！

7060570.en: {callSchool|A}, the Disciples you sent to defend our Sect have all fallen, and our Sect was wiped out by <r>{0}</r>. We can't stay here any longer!
7060570.ch: {callSchool|A}，大事不好！您派遣的守宗弟子已然战死，我宗被<r>{0}</r>彻底抹灭，此地已无我等安身之处！

7060571.en: I was not strong enough and failed to repel <r>{1}</r>'s attack. Now our Sect is breached and all our resources are plundered. Please punish me for my failure!
7060571.ch: 弟子修为不济，没能抵御住<r>{1}</r>的进攻，如今宗门被破，宗内资源被洗劫一空，弟子实在罪该万死，还请宗主大人责罚！

7060572.en: {callSchool|A}, now that our Sect is no more, we can only continue our cultivation as Rogue Cultivators... If we could rise again, we'll probably bring our Sect back!
7060572.ch: {callSchool|A}，如今宗门被灭，我等只能沦落为散修了……倘若日后东山再起，也许还能复兴宗门大业！

7060573.en: Sect Leader, now that there is no more Sect of a shared origin with us, we can only continue our cultivation as Rogue Cultivators... If we could rise again, we'll probably bring our Sect back!
7060573.ch: 宗主大人，如今八荒山海中已无我宗的任何一处同源宗门，我等只能沦落为散修了……倘若日后东山再起，也许还能复兴宗门大业！

7060591.en: Sect Leader, please forgive my impudence, but I have attained {grade|B}, and <r>{1}</r> defending <r>{0}</r> is only {grade|C}. If I should attack that opponent, it might backfire and affect my cultivation. A Sect member at <r>{2}</r> should be more suitable to handle an enemy of that level. Please do allow me to resign from this position.
7060591.ch: 宗主大人，弟子不才，如今修为已臻{grade|B}，而坐镇于<r>{0}</r>的<r>{1}</r>才不过区区{grade|C}，我若对其贸然出手，恐怕会心境动摇、修为受阻。对付此等货色，一个<r>{2}</r>的同门已然足矣，故弟子愿让出此职，还望宗主大人恕罪。

7060592.en: Sect Leader, please forgive my incompetence to still remain at {grade|B}, but <r>{1}</r> defending <r>{0}</r> is already at {grade|C}. If I should attack that opponent, it would be throwing a straw against the wind. <r>{2}</r> would be a better choice for this mission. I don't fear death, but I don't want to see my failure disrupt your plan.
7060592.ch: 宗主大人，弟子驽钝，如今修为区区{grade|B}，而坐镇于<r>{0}</r>的<r>{1}</r>修为已然达到{grade|C}，我若前往抵敌，宛如飞蛾扑火、以卵击石。若想胜过此人，宗主大人还需派遣<r>{2}</r>的同门出战，弟子身死事小，耽误宗门事大，望宗主三思。

7060593.en: Sect Leader, please forgive my impudence, but I have attained {grade|B}, and <r>{1}</r> leading <r>{0}</r> is only {grade|C}. If I should attack that opponent, it might backfire and affect my Root. A Sect member at <r>{2}</r> should be more suitable to handle an enemy of that level. 7060593.ch: 宗主大人，弟子不才，如今修为已臻{grade|B}，而统帅<r>{0}</r>众人的<r>{1}</r>才不过区区{grade|C}，我若对其贸然出手，恐怕会心境动摇、道根受阻。对付此等货色，一个<r>{2}</r>的同门已然足矣，故弟子愿让出此职，还望宗主大人恕罪。

7060594.en: Sect Leader, please forgive my incompetence to still remain at {grade|B}, but <r>{1}</r> leading <r>{0}</r> is already at {grade|C}. If I should attack that opponent, it would be throwing a straw against the wind. <r>{2}</r> would be a better choice for this mission. I don't fear death, but I don't want to see my failure disrupt your plan.
7060594.ch: 宗主大人，弟子驽钝，如今修为区区{grade|B}，而统帅<r>{0}</r>众人的<r>{1}</r>修为已然达到{grade|C}，我若前往抵敌，宛如飞蛾扑火、以卵击石。若想胜过此人，宗主大人还需派遣<r>{2}</r>的同门出战，弟子身死事小，耽误宗门事大，望宗主三思。

7060601.en: <r>{0}</r>, forget about your scheme! We <r>{2}</r> will help defend <r>{1}</r> at all costs!
7060601.ch: <r>{0}</r>之人休要放肆，今有我<r>{2}</r>众人倾宗门之力在此相助，定使<r>{1}</r>无懈可击、坚不可摧！

7060611.en: <r>{0}</r> is about to invade <r>{1}</r>. We can't overlook such atrocities!
7060611.ch: <r>{0}</r>即将入侵<r>{1}</r>，对于此等卑劣行径，我等岂能袖手旁观！

7060612.en: <r>{0}</r> is about to mount an attack against <r>{1}</r>. We <r>{2}</r> can't stand by and watch them die! {callSchool|A}, prepare for battle to help {1} defend their Sect!
7060612.ch: <r>{0}</r>即将发动对<r>{1}</r>的进攻，我<r>{2}</r>绝不等见死不救！大战一触即发，请{callSchool|A}做好准备，帮助{1}守住宗门！

7060631.en: {callSchool|A}, we need a leader if we want to defend the Sect. After discussion, we all think you should be the deputy Sect Leader. You will surely lead us to crush the enemy!
7060631.ch: {callSchool|A}，如今我等合力镇守宗门，尚缺一名领袖，众人商议后决定推举您为代理宗主，统御三军。相信在您的率领下，我等必能克敌制胜！

7060632.en: {callSchool|A}, it's time for true heroes to shine. Sect Leader has decided to grant you the authority of a True Disciple. You may now follow the Elders into the Guardian Battle to fight against enemy Sects. Take this rare opportunity and show your strength!
7060632.ch: {callSchool|A}，如今正是用人之际，宗主决定给予你真传弟子的权限，可随众长老前往神兽战场阻击敌宗，此乃千载难逢之机，想必你能大显身手、一展神威！

7060641.en: Please have faith in us, Sect Leader. We will bring back all the yields of this resource point to our Sect!
7060641.ch: 请宗主大人放心，弟子二人势必将该资源点的产出尽数带回，为宗门发展贡献一份绵薄之力！

7060651.en: <r>{1}</r> and we <r>{2}</r> shared a same origin, and now it has been captured by <r>{0}</r>. We <r>{2}</r> must help them out! Next month, we will mount an attack against <r>{1}</r> to reclaim the lost land and restore our glory!
7060651.ch: <r>{1}</r>与我<r>{2}</r>曾是同源宗门，然其遭逢歹人毒手，如今正被<r>{0}</r>霸占。对于此等夺宗之辱，我<r>{2}</r>岂能忍气吞声！下个月，我宗将大举进攻<r>{1}</r>，此战我等势必夺回失地，重振宗门荣光！

7060652.en: We <r>{3}</r>'s capture of <r>{1}</r> irritated <r>{2}</r>. They plan to invade our <r>{0}</r> next month to reclaim lost land. We must be fully prepared for the attack, defend our territory, and repel the enemy.
7060652.ch: 我<r>{3}</r>当年攻占<r>{1}</r>之事惹恼了<r>{2}</r>，他们将在下月大举入侵我<r>{0}</r>，图谋夺回失地。我宗上下必须做足准备、严阵以待，必定要守住领地，击退来犯之人。

7060653.en: <r>{1}</r> lost their Sect to us <r>{2}</r>, yet they don't know when to give up. They rallied a mob and plan to attack us <r>{0}</r> next month in the hope of reclaiming their lost land. We will rout them again to make them know the futility of their defiance.
7060653.ch: <r>{1}</r>被我<r>{2}</r>抹灭了宗门还不知悔改，竟纠集一帮乌合之众，意图于下月进攻我<r>{0}</r>以期夺回失地。此举宛如飞蛾扑火，我等势必将再次击溃这些冥顽不灵之辈。

7060654.en: <r>{1}</r> and we <r>{2}</r> shared a same origin, and now it has been captured by <r>{0}</r>. We <r>{2}</r> must help them out! Next month, we will mount an attack against <r>{1}</r>. Though they have the assistance from <r>{3}</r>, we will reclaim the lost land and restore our glory!
7060654.ch: <r>{1}</r>与我<r>{2}</r>曾是同源宗门，然其遭逢歹人毒手，如今正被<r>{0}</r>霸占。对于此等夺宗之辱，我<r>{2}</r>岂能忍气吞声！下个月，我宗将大举进攻<r>{1}</r>，尽管对方有<r>{3}</r>支援，但此战我等势必夺回失地，重振宗门荣光！

7060655.en: We <r>{4}</r>'s capture of <r>{1}</r> irritated <r>{2}</r>. They plan to invade our <r>{0}</r> next month to reclaim lost land. Though we have secured the assistance from <r>{3}</r>, we must still work hard to be fully prepared for the attack to defend our territory and repel the enemy.
7060655.ch: 我<r>{4}</r>当年攻占<r>{1}</r>之事惹恼了<r>{2}</r>，他们将在下月大举入侵我<r>{0}</r>，图谋夺回失地。我宗虽有<r>{3}</r>相助，但仍需做足准备、严阵以待，争取守住领地，击退来犯之人。

7060656.en: <r>{1}</r> lost their Sect to us <r>{4}</r>, yet they don't know when to give up. They rallied a mob and plan to attack us <r>{0}</r> next month in the hope of reclaiming their lost land. With <r>{3}</r>'s assistance, we will rout them again to make them know the futility of their defiance.
7060656.ch: <r>{1}</r>被我<r>{4}</r>抹灭了宗门还不知悔改，竟纠集一帮乌合之众，意图于下月进攻我<r>{0}</r>夺回失地。此举宛如飞蛾扑火，我等有<r>{3}</r>鼎力相助，势必再次击溃这些冥顽不灵之辈。

7070001.en: You're so puny against me. Why don't you hang yourself to save yourself from humiliation?
7070001.ch: 就你这点能耐，在我面前如同蝼蚁，还是趁早自挂东南枝吧！

7070031.en: I've never met someone brazen as you!
7070031.ch: 我从未见过有如此厚颜无耻之人！

7070032.en: Quit bullshitting! Fight me, or get out of my sight!
7070032.ch: 你放屁！要杀便杀，不然就赶紧滚蛋！

7070033.en: Shut up! How dare you talk nonsense here!
7070033.ch: 住口！无耻老贼安敢在此犬吠！

7070034.en: Well, well, what else do you expect from the mouth of a wild dog?
7070034.ch: 不愧是你，真真狗嘴吐不出当康牙！

7070035.en: A load of crap. Have you finished?

7070041.en: I was blind when I decided to marry a scum like you!
7070041.ch: 当初我真是瞎了眼，与你这等货色结为夫妻！

7070051.en: I never knew you were such a faithless person...

7070061.en: I've always been faithful to this relationship, and this is what I get...
7070061.ch: 我一片真心，竟落得如此下场……

7070081.en: I wasted all my youth on you rat!
7070081.ch: 也罢，我权当这些年的青春都喂了当康。

7070091.en: A weakling like you wants to remain my Partner?
7070091.ch: 这般修为，也配当我的道侣？

7070101.en: I flattered myself all these years...
7070101.ch: 这么些年，怪我自作多情了……

7070121.en: Hmph, you rat, I wasted so many years on you.
7070121.ch: 哼，没良心的东西，这么多年权当我在遛狗了。

7070131.en: Sorry I forgot you were so old and weak. I used only a fraction of my power, and you were already down.
7070131.ch: 全怪徒儿太不懂尊老，我刚使出半分功力，师父您老人家就躺下了。

7070161.en: You dirty rat! How dare you betray your master! You are condemned!
7070161.ch: 大胆逆徒，既欺师灭祖，日后必遭天谴。

7070171.en: Cultivation is not your thing. Just go home and be a peasant.
7070171.ch: 不成器的东西，修仙不适合你，还是趁早回家找块田种吧。

7070181.en: I... I am such a failure...
7070181.ch: 原来……原来我竟如此不堪……

7070201.en: Ha, you old devil is no better than me!
7070201.ch: 哈，你这老不死的玩意恐怕也好不到哪里去！

7070211.en: I am way above you in the rank of strength. You don't feel ashamed to be called {call|A|B} by me?
7070211.ch: 论道行，你和我之间可差着辈分，我叫你一声{call|A|B}你也不知道害臊？

7070231.en: Have you forgotten what I did for you before...
7070231.ch: 你竟如此不顾往日情分……

7070251.en: Oh? So you want to be my lackey?
7070251.ch: 哦？这么说你要认我做个爹娘？

7070261.en: You should know when to give up at your age. Don't outstay your welcome in this world.
7070261.ch: 老大不小的人了，可千万别跟自己较劲，该咽气就咽气吧。

7070271.ch: 你你你……你这不孝子……咳咳，咳……

7070291.en: You scurvy wretch! You will be split into pieces by lightning!
7070291.ch: 大胆逆子，你如此忤逆不孝，日后必被天雷劈为齑粉！

7070301.ch: 我可从来没认过你这么个倒霉玩意儿！

7070331.en: Ha, you old devil, who do you think you are to criticize me?
7070331.ch: 哈，你这老不死的玩意，有什么资格说这种屁话！

7070341.en: Just stay in your lair until you learn some real skills. You're making a fool of yourself out here!
7070341.ch: 没练出个名堂之前，就学乌龟好好趴着，少出来丢人现眼！

7070371.en: Who do you think you are to judge me?
7070371.ch: 哪来的野狗。也敢教育我？

7070381.en: I can't believe you're still so weak at your current Realm! Did you feed on dark energy to cultivate?
7070381.ch: 如此境界竟就这点能耐，你怕是吸冥气长大的？

7070391.en: I'm just a mediocrity? No... Impossible!
7070391.ch: 我竟然只是平庸之辈。不……这不可能！

7070411.en: Hmph, every dog will have his day. You'll be sorry for despising me today!
7070411.ch: 哼，三十年河东三十年河西，莫欺少年穷！

7070421.en: {name|C} told me the other day about making a new friend who is both a fool and a joke. Could it be you?
7070421.ch: {name|C}前些天跟我说，最近结识了一个傻狍子，与之交往权当看跳梁小丑取乐，莫非那狍子竟是阁下？

7070431.en: So... that's what people think about me...

7070451.en: Were you guys born in the same slum? No wonder you're vulgar in the same way.
7070451.ch: 你们果然是一丘之貉，真是狗嘴吐不出当康牙！

7070461.en: No Sect would be so foolish as to recruit a scoundrel like you!
7070461.ch: 你这种杂碎，能有宗门愿意收留那可真见鬼了。

7070491.en: Who do you think you are to judge me? You're only a parasite on your Sect!
7070491.ch: 依靠宗门庇护的乌龟也敢对我指指点点？

7070501.en: You're still so weak even after joining a Sect. What a loser.
7070501.ch: 加入了宗门还如此不堪，真是烂泥扶不上墙。

7070511.en: How... How... dare... you... say that... about my Sect...
7070511.ch: 我我……我的宗门……岂……岂容你妄议……

7070531.en: Such big talk from a deserted loser!
7070531.ch: 没人要的孤魂野鬼也好意思说大话！

7070541.en: A loser like you will only waste the Qi in this world. Why don't you kill yourself and make a contribution to this world once?
7070541.ch: 似你这般杂碎，修行纯粹是浪费八荒的灵气，还是早些自我了断吧。

7070551.en: So my struggle... was all in vain...
7070551.ch: 原来我的一切努力……不过都是徒劳……

7070561.en: How... how dare you insult me...

7070581.en: Perhaps... this is my fate after all...

7070591.en: ... (Your opponent stands still in a daze for a long time after hearing your words)
7070591.ch: ……（对方听完你说的话，便愣在原地许久）

7070601.en: ... (Your opponent racks their brain for a long time without making a rebuttal)
7070601.ch: ……（对方听完你的话，抓耳挠腮却做不出任何反驳）

7070631.en: A female Dangkang may be the only female creature your grotesque face can attract in this world.
7070631.ch: 阁下这张怪脸，放眼八荒，恐怕只有雌性当康愿意多看两眼。

7070641.en: I... I was born like this... How can you...
7070641.ch: 外表……外表非我所愿……你怎可……

7070661.en: So... this is the real me...

7070681.en: Only shallow people judge others by their appearance. Their hearts are uglier than their faces!
7070681.ch: 只有粗鄙肤浅的小人才会指戳他人外表，殊不知这些人自己也恶臭难当！

7070691.en: You are still alive only because my {relation|C|A} {name|C} is too busy to deal with a puny bug like you.
7070691.ch: 我的{relation|C|A}{name|C}器量非凡，容你活到今天，完全是因为没工夫理睬一只蝼蚁罢了。

7070721.en: You vile beasts are perfect match for each other!
7070721.ch: 果然是一丘之貉，嘴脸都那么令人厌恶！

7070731.en: You're already worn-out? No wonder your {relation|C|B} {name|X} wants to be my Partner.
7070731.ch: 这么快就精血竭尽了？难怪你的{relation|C|B}{name|X}要同我结为道侣。

7070741.en: How dare you disrupt my relationship with {name|C}!
7070741.ch: 我与{name|C}多年的感情，竟被你这等小人玷污！

7070761.en: Scumbag! Karma is going to get you sooner or later!
7070761.ch: 卑鄙小人，行出此事者，早晚被他人做出同样之事！

7070771.en: After seeing you in person, I understand why your {relation|C|B} {name|C} wants to find a new Partner.
7070771.ch: 你这般不堪，难怪你的{relation|C|B}{name|C}会另寻他人相交。

7070811.en: Do you know your {relation|C|B} {name|X} has become my Partner?
7070811.ch: 你的{relation|C|B}{name|X}与我结为道侣，此事你可知晓？

7070821.en: {name|C}, your Partner? How can {gender|C} betray me?
7070821.ch: {name|C}竟也是你的道侣？{gender|C}怎能如此辜负我！

7070841.en: Hmph, if it happened to me, won't it happen to you one day?
7070841.ch: 哼哼，你又怎知自己不会遭逢此事？

7070851.en: You are even no better than the Mushroom Man throwing two mushrooms!
7070851.ch: 就你这两下子，还不如路边药灵扔两根蘑菇强。

7070881.en: Oh? Mushroom Man is born from the essence of plants and way better than a barbarian like you.
7070881.ch: 哦？药灵乃草木精华所生，不知比阁下这种粗鄙俗物高过多少。

7070891.en: You must be too stupid to grasp the Manual, or how can you end up such a loser?
7070891.ch: 你这点脑筋，怕是秘籍上的字都认不全吧，不然怎会练成这副德行？

7070901.en: So all my struggle these years was in vain...
7070901.ch: 难道我这么多年的苦练，都是徒劳……

7070921.en: Don't make me laugh! I've never met a real talent who talks nonsense like you.
7070921.ch: 可笑！我见过的聪颖之辈，可不会似阁下这般犬吠。

7070931.en: You bring shame to our {school|B}, loser!
7070931.ch: 我{school|B}什么时候出了你这等废物，真是败坏门楣！

7070941.en: So I'm only a burden to {school|B}...

7070961.en: Cut the crap! Our sect doesn't need a maniac like you!
7070961.ch: 屁话真多，说完了没？我宗留你这条狗可不是为了乱咬人的！

7070971.en: You're a shit with a pair of hands and legs!
7070971.ch: 你就是一个长了一双手两条腿的废物！

7070981.en: So that's what people think about me...
7070981.ch: 我竟是这样一无是处的废物……

7070991.en: You're going too far and it won't do you any good... Please... please watch your tongue...
7070991.ch: 阁下口出恶言于人于己都没什么好处……请……请留几分口德……

7071001.en: Verbal abuse hurts more than iron spears...
7071001.ch: 伤人以言，果然深于矛戈……

7071011.ch: 绝对不可能，我怎么可能是这样的人？

7071041.en: Then you're a rabid dog with a human tongue!
7071041.ch: 那我观阁下便是长了一条长舌的野犬罢了。

7071051.en: To carry stones for the Foolish Old Man may be the only suitable job for a weakling like you.
7071051.ch: 以你的修为，帮助愚公挖挖石头可正合适。

7071111.en: And you are not even fit to carry his shoes!
7071111.ch: 我看你之品性，连给愚公老人家提鞋都不配！

7071121.en: Forget about cultivation. Just go back home to cultivate crops!
7071121.ch: 朋友，听我一句劝，就你还修仙，修脚去吧！

7071131.en: How can you say such a thing...
7071131.ch: 你竟说出这样狠心的话来……

7071161.en: Isn't that the perfect job for someone at your level?
7071161.ch: 我看阁下这身修为，更适合给人搓背吧！

7071211.en: As for your face, I would say it can attract more peculiar things!
7071211.ch: 我观你的姿色，倒确实妙不可言，哈哈哈！

7071221.en: After seeing your face, I even find a Leviathan good-looking.
7071221.ch: 看完你这张脸，我突然感觉何罗鱼也挺眉清目秀的。

7071261.en: Compared to your face, even a female Dangkang looks charming!
7071261.ch: 那看完你的脸，我觉得雌性当康也无比妖娆美艳！

7071271.en: You have lived for so long, yet your strength cannot even match that of a Bambuki.
7071271.ch: 你活了这么久怎么修为还不如一只竹妖？

7071311.en: And you don't even know how to behave better than a bamboo!
7071311.ch: 你长了这么大，素质还不如一根竹子！

7071341.en: Only my parents can say that to me... How dare you...
7071341.ch: 我爹娘才能这么说我……你竟敢……

7071371.en: Just find a Partner and go back home! A weakling like you has no future in the world of cultivation!
7071371.ch: 攒点钱讨个道侣过小日子吧，似你这般废物，在修仙界根本活不下去。

7071391.en: You... It's none of your business!

7071411.en: A swaggerer like you will meet your end soon!
7071411.ch: 你这般口出狂言，不出几年必定死于他人之手！

7071421.en: If I kill you here, what do you think will happen to your Partners?
7071421.ch: 若我抬手取你狗命，猜猜你那一屋子道侣会何去何从啊？

7071441.en: It's a problem between you and me. It has nothing to do with others!
7071441.ch: 一人做事一人当，你不能……不能牵连他人！

7071461.en: They will shred you to pieces!
7071461.ch: 怕是会将你碎尸万段吧。

7071471.en: Your Partners are all rare beauties. I will take good care of them! Hahaha!
7071471.ch: 你的妻子道侣个个是八荒绝色，在下甚是满意，啧啧！

7071491.en: No... Impossible! They will never do that to me!
7071491.ch: 不……不可能！我不相信她们会做出这种事！

7071521.en: A famous wimp, but still a wimp. Just go back to Bai Yuan to live the rest of your life in peace!
7071521.ch: 区区一个草包竟还有点名气，赶紧回白源区养老吧，省得晚节不保。

7071531.en: How dare you... insult me! You...
7071531.ch: 你怎敢……对我如此不敬，你你……

7071541.en: How can you understand my struggle...

7071561.en: A load of crap. Have you finished? Who do you think you are to judge me?
7071561.ch: 屁话真多，说完了没？哪来的野狗竟敢指点于我！

7071571.en: I heard you know something about Feng Shui. Why don't you find a good grave for yourself and move there to save you a miserable death?
7071571.ch: 听说你精通风水，看你这修为，趁早给自己选块坟头跳进去，免得曝尸荒野！

7071581.en: I don't deserve to live any longer after losing to you...
7071581.ch: 既败于你手，我也无颜苟活……

7071611.en: Well, I'll find one for you first since you'll need it soon!
7071611.ch: 好说好说，我也顺便替你寻得一处风水宝地，待你死于非命就能即刻用上！

7071621.en: It must be hard for a wimp like you to find a Sect, right?
7071621.ch: 像你这样的杂碎，天下间的宗门都不肯将你收于门下吧？

7071631.en: So... I'm just a wandering ghost...
7071631.ch: 难道……我还不如一个孤魂野鬼……

7071651.en: What kind of wimp relies on the Sect to cultivate? You can't even survive without a Sect, right?
7071651.ch: 什么样的废物还需要依靠宗门修仙？离了宗门，怕是连吃奶都不会了？

7071661.en: How dare a scum like you provoke me? I'll let you live for a few more days if you kneel down and kowtow to me.
7071661.ch: 区区一粒渣滓，也敢与我为敌？趁早跪下磕几个响的，我兴许能让你多活几日。

7071701.en: You just bite at whoever you see, don't you? You're the worst beast in this world!
7071701.ch: 见人就咬，阁下不愧是八荒第一恶犬！

7071711.en: Heaven-chosen? Is your Taoist Mind called "Wimp"?
7071711.ch: 这就是所谓的天骄？你的道心是不是叫“废柴”？

7071721.en: How dare you... insult me! I...
7071721.ch: 你竟敢……对我如此不敬……我我我……

7071751.en: Is your Taoist Mind called "Empty Talk"?
7071751.ch: 那么阁下的道心是不是叫做“犬吠”？

7075001.en: {call|B|A}, I feel disturbed lately about my future. What path should I take to further cultivate? Could you give me some advice?
7075001.ch: {call|B|A}，我近日心绪烦乱，迷惘于日后修道路途如何抉择，不知{call|B|A}你能否助我拨云见日？

7075011.en: {call|B|A}, I have peeked at the Great Path and seen the mystery of Rewrite Destiny, but I can't make up my mind as to what route I should take to reach there. Could you give me some guidance?
7075011.ch: {call|B|A}，我有幸得窥大道，略知那逆天改命玄妙无穷，却迟迟难以决定参悟何种，不知{call|B|A}你能否为我指明道路？

7075012.en: {call|B|A}, thank you for your consideration! My problem has been solved, and you don't need to worry about it anymore. Thank you all the same!
7075012.ch: {call|B|A}，多谢你为我的烦恼操劳！眼下我得偿所愿，无需你再奔波，此事虽非你所为，但你的心意我已然心领。

7075013.en: {call|B|A}, thank you for your help. If I could one day master Rewrite Destiny, I will follow your advice.
7075013.ch: {call|B|A}，多谢你为我解惑，若我有幸能够参悟此逆天改命，必然遵从你的意愿。

7097001.en: {call|A|B}, I've long since heard of your good name as <r>{0}</r>. If I can beat you, please hand over this title to the one more worthy of it.
7097001.ch: {call|A|B}，久闻你<r>{0}</r>之盛名，今日我特来讨教。若你于此道之上稍逊于我，还望将这道号让于配位之人。

7097011.en: As <r>{0}</r>, I have the courage to face any challenge. Bring it on!
7097011.ch: 身怀<r>{0}</r>的名号，便要有与之相配的器量。对于各路挑战之人，我一向来者不拒，出招吧！

7097021.en: {call|B|A}, you're the renowned <r>{0}</r>? I walk the same path as you, and I'd like to challenge you today. If I win, you need to hand over the title of <r>{0}</r> to me.
7097021.ch: {call|B|A},你便是大名鼎鼎的<r>{0}</r>？正好我也精于此道，便想在你面前领教一番，若我侥幸能胜，这<r>{0}</r>之名我就收下了。

7097041.en: I'm not your rival in this path. Please take the title of {0}.
7097041.ch: 此道之上，我的确不是你的对手，这{0}之名我情愿拱手让你。

7097051.en: How dare a weakling like you covet the title of {0}? Forget it and save you some face.
7097051.ch: 仅凭这点修为也想觊觎{0}之名？我劝你趁早打消此念，以免贻笑大方。
